rationale: Inner1 retains grounded fill with bounded control routes and short motor-pin transitions totaling no more than 8 mm per phase. Motor trunks use outer/inner2 copper. Every phase transition is at least 0.30 mm wide and must pass full-budget thermal, physical connectivity, clearance, ground-plane area and USB reference checks.
USB_construction_reference_rationale: Pair outer edge is 0.330 mm from the centreline. A 0.400 mm construction buffer plus the existing 0.15 mm copper clearance and 0.02 mm grid margin leaves 0.04 mm beyond the 0.20 mm ground-fill setback. Final exact full-track ground-reference geometry remains mandatory.
